title: Function Health
description: Warm paper and terracotta: a beige page with cream tiles, midnight text, one terracotta brand colour used for pills and italic emphasis, and a light high-contrast serif for every heading over a light rounded grotesk. Pill buttons, 12–24 px rounded cards, hairlines, almost no shadow.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a midnight sibling with the same terracotta
Newsreader stands in for Financier Display (closed), Hanken Grotesk for FT Base (closed), DM Mono for Fragment Mono
page-gutter is fluid (20px phone to ~96px desktop), so blocks use px-gutter without extra breakpoints
